value.rationale: A current primary paper proves symmetric balancing yet gives only a counterexample for unequal rates. This finding determines the full optimal allocation for every bias and inventory size, quantifies exact tie cases and derives the square-root shift and minimum waste constant. The mapping to a binomial loss explains why proportional allocation fails and provides a directly usable structural solution.
